objective.title: Professional Skeptic
objective.summary: Build Professional Skeptic as a standalone public product repository registered inside The Living Constitution as a governed project.
objective.primary_objective: Create a C-RSP-governed failure-detection agent that audits AI repositories, research claims, and build plans by identifying unsupported claims, missing evidence, build-readiness failures, technical debt risks, evaluation gaps, safety/governance risks, and unresolved required inputs.
objective.governance_objective: Use TLC as the constitutional authority layer, C-RSP as the binding build contract, and the standalone product repository as the reviewable product surface.
objective.user_value: Provide an evidence-grounded professional skeptic that makes AI-assisted research and engineering more contestable, auditable, and resistant to unsupported optimism.

external_services: GitHub public repository access via GitHub REST API
environment_variables: GITHUB_TOKEN — optional — GitHub token for higher rate limits on public repos
